title: Extract alternate tilemap rectangles
changes: Extend the European observed-tilemap resource with two authenticated rectangle alternatives and their eight-byte selector, preserving original guest selection and copy behavior. Eight bytes were unowned in the E172 sample.
validation: Source e195-tilemap-source-n6nl69bd authenticates 126 bytes; Wine e195-tilemap-trace-wine-9x55uknb observes the selector and normal rectangle header plus a native IWRAM cell read. Wine e195-tilemap-wine-9sclx54d preserves 122 other resources, rejects coherent edits, checks altered/mixed reads, compares three interpreter/native readers and exercises both original branch outcomes.

Wine e195-tilemap-scene-wine-yxymrems matches full state, guest clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio for 600 frames with both rectangles and the selector altered. Wine e195-tilemap-cli-wine-3j_wfn2z creates, reuses and verifies 124 matching files.
limitations: The scene log contains a D-Bus pending-call assertion before successful completion; cause unestablished. The alternate branch was controlled but its ordinary copy and other consumers remain open, as do Linux, USA and native Windows. No performance measurements were performed.
